violated_contract: A recoverable dependency failure must not terminate the user-facing request it interrupted: a transport-class provider fault with nothing yet delivered has to be re-issued within the request's remaining budget, and if it still cannot be recovered it must be reported as a failure rather than left indistinguishable from a dependency that legitimately returned nothing.
canonical_prevention: Classify provider exceptions into transport-class (retryable) and request-class (not retryable) at the call boundary, re-issue only while no output has reached the user and the request budget still admits a full attempt, bound each attempt well under the end-to-end deadline so a retry can run at all, and propagate the unrecovered failure reason to the caller that renders and records the outcome.
